title: Introduce KMS Decision Observer and Ephemeral Audit Aggregator
author: Sana Iqbal
description: Context: Customers and internal audits have asked for better explainability and deduplication in our KMS usage and audit pipeline. When requests are routed to alternate KMS providers or different CMK regions due to capacity/residency, operators lacked a reliable signal for why a particular key/provider was chosen. Additionally, high-retry/flaky workloads inflate audit entries which complicates compliance review and increases storage costs. This PR introduces two cooperating components: 1) a KMS Decision Observer that records a compact, signed decision record for each KMS selection (provider, region, policy rules applied, and reason code) and surfaces it to the audit pipeline; 2) an Ephemeral Audit Aggregator that merges repeated audit events from the same logical request window, tags aggregated events with dedup keys, and emits a compact audit envelope to long-term storage. The PR contains: feature implementation, RBAC v2 access controls for the observer read path, KMS policy guard changes (tenant-scoped quota and soft-throttle), a migration script to backfill decision-record indices for the last 30 days, and integration tests simulating cross-region failover. Motivation: Improve compliance traceability while keeping audit volume and KMS call costs bounded. Design decisions: decision records are small JSON blobs signed by the control-plane HSM key and stored in a new compact index separate from the main audit shard to avoid query amplification; aggregator keeps a configurable window (default 10s) keyed by request fingerprint and tenant and performs a lossless merge for retries and idempotent requests. Security considerations: only services with rbac:observer role can read decision records; writes require kms-decision:write capability constrained to the internal serving-runtime. Rollout plan: staged rollout behind a feature flag, start with 10% of tenants in us-west, monitor metric kms.decision.latency and audit.aggregator.dedup_rate for 48 hours, then expand. Backout: feature gate off and purge new index via migration revert. We should ensure it never exceeds 1KB per decision to protect index costs." - Sana Iqbal (author): "Decision records are capped at 900 bytes after base64 signing; added truncation and key normalization in serializer to guarantee bounds." - Priya Nambiar (reviewer): "Are there any additional threat models where a malicious tenant could flood the observer with noisy fingerprints?" - Sana Iqbal (author): "Added tenant-level soft-throttle config and quota enforcement in the KMS routing path; aggregator will drop only after tiered alerting and we emit metrics for operator intervention." - Ellen Park (approver): "Integration tests looked good. Please add docs link in the security runbook before merging." - Sana Iqbal (author): "Docs PRs included; link added to runbook as requested." - CI bot: "integration-tests failed on first run due to flaky test timeout; reran and passed" CI checks: - unit-tests: pass - lint: pass - integration-tests: fail (first run) -> pass (rerun) - e2e: pass - helm-lint: pass - security-scan: pass Risk assessment and mitigation: - Risk: increased write-path latency when signing decision records. Mitigation: signing is batched and async; added latency SLO bump to 10ms p95 for the observer and fallback path to previous behavior if SLO crossed. - Risk: aggregation may hide important low-level events. Mitigation: aggregator keeps a high-fidelity raw buffer for 1 hour and emits both aggregated and raw pointers to the long-term store for regulated tenants. Migration and rollout notes: - Included migration tool tools/migrations/backfill_kms_decisions.go which can be run with --days=30 and supports dry-run - Helm values added to enable feature flag and tuning knobs (window_sec, max_blob_size, tenant_soft_throttle) - Rollout was performed staged: 10% (us-west) -> 30% (us-west+eu) -> global after metrics stabilized Metrics added: kms.decision.observed_total, kms.decision.signed_bytes, audit.aggregator.dedup_rate, audit.aggregator.windowed_events, tenant.kms.soft_throttle_hits Release notes: "Adds a KMS Decision Observer for signed explainability records and an Ephemeral Audit Aggregator that deduplicates repeated audit events to reduce noise and storage costs. RBAC v2 controls added to restrict observer read access. Backfill migration included." Merge outcome: merged via squash-merge by Ellen Park on 2026-02-18. Notes: feature gated behind runtime.feature.kms_decision_observer and enabled gradually for tenants in controlled cohorts. Post-merge actions: - monitor kms.decision.observed_total and audit.aggregator.dedup_rate closely for 72h - run backfill with dry-run for 7 days and then commit backfill for audit index - coordinate with compliance team to validate decision records in staging
